name: United Business Card

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee not explicitly stated on product page; listed under 'No Foreign Transaction Fee' category on Chase site.

rewards.redemption_notes: Miles redeemable via MileagePlus program for United flights and partner awards.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 100,000 bonus miles + 2,000 PQP after you spend $5,000 on purchases in the first 3 months your account is open. Plus, earn 10,000 bonus miles after you add an employee card in the first 3 months.

benefits.title: 2 United Club one-time passes per year
benefits.description: 2 United Club one-time passes per year. Over a $100 value. Relax in comfort while waiting for your flight with complimentary beverages, snacks, high-speed Wi-Fi and more.

benefits.title: Free first checked bag
benefits.description: The primary Cardmember and one traveling companion can each check a first standard bag for free - save up to $200 per roundtrip.

benefits.title: Priority boarding
benefits.description: The primary Cardmember and companions on the same reservation will be invited to board United-operated flights prior to general boarding.

benefits.title: $125 United travel credit
benefits.description: Receive $125 in United TravelBank cash after making 5 United flight purchases of $100 or more each calendar year.

benefits.title: Up to $100 in United Hotels credits
benefits.description: Receive $50 back as a statement credit on both your 1st and 2nd prepaid hotel stays purchased directly through United Hotels, up to $100 each anniversary year.

benefits.title: Up to $100 in credits on rideshare purchases
benefits.description: Enroll to receive up to $100 back as statement credits each calendar year on rideshare purchases: up to $8 back each month Jan-Nov and up to $12 back for December. Yearly opt-in required.

benefits.title: Up to $50 in United travel credits (Avis/Budget)
benefits.description: Receive up to $50 in United travel credits annually when you book Avis or Budget car rental directly through cars.united.com and pay with your card.

benefits.title: Up to $120 in Instacart credits each calendar year
benefits.description: Receive up to $120 in Instacart credits each calendar year for purchases made directly through Instacart. Terms apply.

benefits.title: Up to $100 in credits annually on JSX
benefits.description: Receive up to $100 in credits annually on flights purchased directly through JSX.

benefits.title: Up to $25 in credits on FareLock purchases annually
benefits.description: Receive up to $25 in credits on FareLock purchases annually when you buy FareLock on a United- or United Express-operated flight.

benefits.title: 2 Economy Plus seat upgrades
benefits.description: Earn 2 continental U.S. Economy Plus seat upgrades after spending $25,000 each calendar year.

benefits.title: 25% back on United inflight and Club premium drink purchases
benefits.description: 25% back on United inflight and Club premium drink purchases.

benefits.title: Save 10% or more when booking flights with miles
benefits.description: Save 10% or more when booking flights with miles. Premier members save even more.

benefits.title: 5,000-mile better-together anniversary bonus
benefits.description: Receive a 5,000-mile better-together anniversary bonus when you have the United Business card and a personal United credit card.

lounge_access.notes: 2 United Club one-time passes per year

travel_perks.free_checked_bags: Free first checked bag for primary cardmember and one companion (save up to $200 per roundtrip)

notes: Verified against official Chase product page 2026-07-24. Name updated to 'United Business Card'. APR 19.74%-28.24% variable confirmed. Annual fee $150 confirmed. Signup bonus confirmed (100,000 miles + 2,000 PQP after $5,000 in 3 months). FX fee not explicitly stated on page.
